why_ai: Adversarial contamination problem and growing demand for independent measurement as models multiply.
why_clarity: Scores are numbers, but their validity is unknowable while training data stays undisclosed.
why_digital: Models, benchmarks and reports are all software, bought remotely by labs and enterprises.

why_ai: Per-commit continuous integration check that AI-native tooling and in-house teams can build.
why_clarity: Same did-my-change-help question on every commit, checked against fixed test suites.
why_digital: CI tooling for software teams, delivered and bought entirely online.

why_ai: Adversarial, unknowable contamination question that grows in importance as AI spreads.
why_clarity: Contamination extent is unknowable, so no score can be checked as clean.
why_digital: Benchmarks, corpora and scores are purely digital artefacts sold remotely.

why_ai: Specialists must articulate tacit, context-dependent correctness that models cannot self-define.
why_clarity: Criteria are authored from scratch per domain by experts who never wrote them down.
why_digital: Criteria elicitation and grading happen on screens for remote enterprise buyers.

why_ai: Harnesses and runners are commoditising, open and free mechanisms.
why_clarity: Turning test cases into a number is codified, though the meaning varies by buyer.
why_digital: Software platform for labs and engineering teams, sold and used online.

why_ai: Labs pay only for novel findings their own expert teams missed, under confidentiality.
why_clarity: The deliverable is an unknown capability or risk, with no fixed method.
why_digital: Work on model checkpoints is digital, but few confidential lab relationships shape buying.

why_ai: Structured corpus analysis is automatable, though the proprietary data is a moat.
why_clarity: Agreement and item statistics are computable, but the validity account is research.
why_digital: A structured digital corpus analysed and published online.

why_ai: Rating collection is operations at scale; human input stays needed but corrections are statistical.
why_clarity: Millions of near-identical pairwise ratings, but presentation bias muddies what is measured.
why_digital: Remote raters on online platforms delivering datasets to labs.

why_ai: Judge-human agreement validation is a mechanical, repeatable computation software can run.
why_clarity: Agreement rates per task are an exact, objectively checkable statistic.
why_digital: Graders, outputs and validation reports are all digital and remotely sold.

why_ai: Every source of score movement is logged, so attribution debugging is highly automatable.
why_clarity: The same model-or-measurement question recurs and can be checked against recorded runs.
why_digital: Debugging logs, parsers and scores entirely on screen.

why_ai: Practising specialists reconstruct correct answers on hard cases, though model judges compete.
why_clarity: Rubrics do not fit the specialist judgment, and correctness is slow to confirm.
why_digital: Remote specialists rate model outputs on online platforms.
